title: Return the absolute value
prompt: Write `distance_from_zero`, which returns how far a number is from zero, always positive, using the built-in abs(). `solve` returns distance_from_zero(n).
hints: Wrapping a built-in in your own well-named function is a normal thing to do.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.

docs.name: abs(n)
docs.what: Returns n without its sign: abs(-5) is 5.
